page.layout: One page of running text in a single column. No margin notes. Running head at top left, page number at top right. Gathering signature "m 5" below the last line.

main_text.p: quidé in caufis confiderāda virtus ipsa,q̄ & per se est laudabilis, & laudabiles alios reddit: deinde naturæ bonitas, ingenij præstantia, educatio parentum, præcepto rum institutio. In effectibus spectandæ a-ctiones, munera, & officia ipsarum virtu-tum, quæ sententias laudantes egregias suppeditant: modo ex doctrina Ethica propria singulis virtutibus officia tri-buantur, nec illis vicina nobis vitia impo nant. In consequentibus videnda, quæ ex honestis & præclaris actionibus sequun-tur prima: honores, dignitates, opes, pri-uilegia, & quæ huius sunt generis alia. In adiunctis ratio habenda, nationis, patriæ, familiæ, pulcritudinis, diuitiarum, &c. & vt ad laudem illa aliquid saciant, μελιοκῶ quodam ἠθικὰ reddenda, vsu scili-cet eorūdem moderato ac laudabili mon-strato. Comparatorum etiam locus adhi-bendus, conferendaq; persona, quæ lau-danda cum aliis claris, nobilibus,illustri-bus: ob virtutem & cætera, cùm corporis, tùm fortunæ bona: ita tamen vt omnis a-dulationis atq; assentationis suspicio re-moueatur: & ostendatur: nihil nos gratiæ hic cuiusquam dare: non auribus aliorum inseruire: sed vnicam propositam verita-

page.notes: The Greek word before "quodam" (rendered μελιοκῶ) is uncertain and should be checked against the scan. The Greek word "ἠθικὰ" is a best reading and may be inexact. Ligatures and the "s" long s are normalised to plain s. The first line's "s" was rendered as "s" and "quidé" keeps its printed acute accent. Some Latin words after "saciant" and "quodam" are partly obscured in the scan; "saciant" is read as "aciant" in the image and may need checking.
